column3: Close to the Hebrew; חָמָס (“violence”) is rendered “concerning wrong.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the men of my council” is rendered “my close friends.”
NKJV renders גֹּאֲלִי (“my vindicator, kinsman-redeemer”) as “my Redeemer,” capitalized, and “on dust” as “on the earth.”
The Hebrew is difficult; NKJV supplies “this I know” and renders “from my flesh” as “in my flesh.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my kidneys faint within me” is rendered “How my heart yearns within me!”
Close to the Hebrew; “wrath is iniquities of the sword” is rendered “wrath brings the punishment of the sword.”
